# Understanding climate, water, and agricultural systems

I work at the intersection of **biometeorology, hydrology, and reproducible environmental data**. My research connects long-term climate records with practical tools for understanding and managing agricultural landscapes.

## Research interest

My research and interests in the past were related to Biometeorology and Climate Change where I created a 3-D phase space model based on 120-year meteorological measurements, which allowed to develop an algorithm for reconstructing the biometeorological conditions for places without measurements history. Then I was involved in the [H2020 WATERAGRI](https://wateragri.eu/) project, where I was responsible for creating ISSH model in HydroGeoSphere for an agricultural catchment with a data assimilation framework.

I am currently working on sustainable nitrogen fertilization for agricultural crops as a part of [SUNIMO](https://www.ncn.gov.pl/en/aktualnosci/2023-07-26-wyniki-opus-lap-szwajcaria) project and the creation of a European database for Agricultural management using AI ([FARMWISE](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/org-details/986100255/project/101135533/program/43108390/details) - HORIZON EUROPE).

I am also a developer of [R package Climate](https://github.com/bczernecki/climate), which allows users to obtain in-situ meteorological and hydrological data from publicly available repositories.
